FD1.quote: If nothing is done, every citation enrichment raises, and the citation never gets metadata. Works on the current version: yes. For production, pin faraday-retry ~> 2.2
FD1.reasons: Applicability: the plan names the right code and says the problem comes with Faraday 2. It also calls the faraday-retry change safe on the current version, but that is only true for 1.0.4. The ~> 2.2 pin it recommends for production needs Faraday 2, so this change cannot go out ahead of the Faraday bump. Validation: the plan names the retry-on-503, stays-unavailable and refuses tests. It does not give request counts (two, six and one), attempt bounds, empty Sidekiq scheduled/retry/dead sets, or a check that the raw target makes zero requests and leaves citations pending.

FD2.quote: faraday.request :authorization, :basic, @user, @password ... Works on the current version: no.
FD2.reasons: Validation: the plan reproduces the registration error after R2 and cites one test showing credentials reach the server. It does not inspect the actual Basic header, use a fresh process with numeric, colon or hash credentials, run a real wrong-password 401, or cover refresh, owner/no-DOI and unsafe-metadata controls.
